migration.reason: Existing schema already has Order totals, SellerOrder, OrderItem snapshots and Inventory. The remaining Inventory partial unique index requires duplicate-data preflight before migration.

findings.evidence: Fixed by requiring ADMIN session in app/api/staffs/route.tsx, validating payload with Zod, and omitting password from the response. Verification: eslint, typecheck, Prisma validate, security tests, and production build passed.
findings.description: Staff creation is publicly callable and does not hash the supplied password before returning the created object.
findings.businessImpact: Unauthenticated users can create staff-like records or poison staff data; plaintext password handling would compromise accounts if wired to persistence.
findings.recommendedSolution: Require ADMIN session, validate input with Zod, hash passwords with bcrypt, persist through Prisma intentionally, and return a sanitized response.
findings.verificationSteps: Unauthenticated POST /api/staffs should return 401; USER/SELLER should return 403; ADMIN creation should store a bcrypt hash and omit password in response.
findings.reproducibility: Previously reproducible from missing route/session checks. Guard and test coverage now prevent the audited path.

findings.evidence: Fixed by requiring ADMIN session for app/api/users/route.tsx GET and sanitizing returned users. Verification: eslint, typecheck, Prisma validate, security tests, and production build passed.
findings.description: The users list endpoint exposes all user records publicly.
findings.businessImpact: Customer, seller, admin and credential-adjacent account data can be enumerated by unauthenticated clients.
findings.recommendedSolution: Protect with ADMIN-only authorization, select minimal fields, paginate, and avoid returning password/verificationToken fields.
findings.verificationSteps: Unauthenticated GET /api/users returns 401; non-admin returns 403; admin response excludes password and tokens.
findings.reproducibility: Previously reproducible from missing route/session checks. Guard and test coverage now prevent the audited path.

findings.evidence: Fixed by requiring id+verification token in app/api/users/verify/route.tsx, rate limiting attempts, updating by matching verificationToken, and clearing the token after use. Verification: eslint, typecheck, Prisma validate, security tests, and production build passed.
findings.description: Email verification can be completed by knowing or guessing a user id.
findings.businessImpact: Attackers can mark accounts verified without mailbox control, weakening seller/customer onboarding trust.
findings.recommendedSolution: Require id plus verification token, store token expiry, use constant-time comparison or hashed tokens, clear token after use.
findings.verificationSteps: PUT /api/users/verify with only an id should fail; valid id+token succeeds once and cannot be reused.
findings.reproducibility: Previously reproducible from missing route/session checks. Guard and test coverage now prevent the audited path.

findings.evidence: Fixed by requiring id+reset token in app/api/users/update-password/route.tsx, rate limiting attempts, updating by matching verificationToken, and clearing the token after use. Forgot-password now stores the generated token. Verification: eslint, typecheck, Prisma validate, security tests, and production build passed.
findings.description: Password reset trusts client-supplied id and has no token validation.
findings.businessImpact: Anyone who can call the endpoint can change another account password if they know the user id.
findings.recommendedSolution: Require a valid unexpired reset token tied to the user, hash and store token server-side, invalidate after use, and rate-limit attempts.
findings.verificationSteps: PUT /api/users/update-password with id+password and no token must fail; valid token succeeds once.
findings.reproducibility: Previously reproducible from missing route/session checks. Guard and test coverage now prevent the audited path.

findings.evidence: Fixed by requiring a session in app/api/orders/user/[id]/route.tsx and allowing only owner-or-admin access. Verification: eslint, typecheck, Prisma validate, security tests, and production build passed.
findings.description: Customer order lookup trusts the URL user id.
findings.businessImpact: Any caller can retrieve another customer order history by changing the id.
findings.recommendedSolution: Require session; allow ADMIN or session.user.id === params.id; sellers should use seller-scoped order APIs.
findings.verificationSteps: USER A requesting USER B orders should receive 403; unauthenticated request should receive 401.
findings.reproducibility: Previously reproducible from missing route/session checks. Guard and test coverage now prevent the audited path.

findings.evidence: Fixed by requiring an authenticated session in app/api/orders/route.tsx POST, validating checkout payload with Zod, and deriving userId from session.user.id instead of request body. Verification: eslint, typecheck, Prisma validate, security tests, and production build passed.
findings.description: Order creation trusts the client-supplied user id.
findings.businessImpact: Orders can be created under another account, corrupting order ownership, invoice ownership, and customer history.
findings.recommendedSolution: Require getServerSession and derive userId from session.user.id; reject mismatched body ids; validate checkout data server-side.
findings.verificationSteps: Authenticated USER A posting body userId of USER B should create under USER A or fail with 403.
findings.reproducibility: Previously reproducible from missing route/session checks. Guard and test coverage now prevent the audited path.

findings.evidence: Fixed for audited back-office mutation surface by adding admin guards to staff, category, banner, market, farmer, subcategory, training and HSN write routes; coupon writes are authenticated and seller-scoped. Verification: eslint, typecheck, Prisma validate, security tests, and production build passed.
findings.description: Back-office mutation APIs are largely public.
findings.businessImpact: Unauthenticated users can alter catalog, promotions, tax master, and content data.
findings.recommendedSolution: Add deny-by-default auth wrappers for route handlers and enforce ADMIN/SELLER ownership per resource.
findings.verificationSteps: Unauthenticated POST/PUT/DELETE against catalog routes should return 401; wrong role should return 403.
findings.reproducibility: Previously reproducible from missing route/session checks. Guard and test coverage now prevent the audited path.

findings.evidence: Fixed by adding dashboard route role matrix enforcement in proxy.ts via canAccessDashboardPath. Verification: eslint, typecheck, Prisma validate, security tests, and production build passed.
findings.description: Dashboard routing requires login but not role authorization.
findings.businessImpact: A normal USER can potentially access admin or seller pages by URL if page-level checks are absent.
findings.recommendedSolution: Define route-to-role matrix and enforce it in middleware or dashboard layouts plus server-side data access.
findings.verificationSteps: Sign in as USER and request admin/seller dashboard URLs; expect 403/redirect.
findings.reproducibility: Previously reproducible from missing route/session checks. Guard and test coverage now prevent the audited path.

findings.evidence: Fixed by requiring authentication in app/api/sales/route.tsx and scoping non-admin queries to vendorId=session.user.id. Verification: eslint, typecheck, Prisma validate, security tests, and production build passed.
findings.description: Seller order filtering is performed after fetching all seller sales data.
findings.businessImpact: Seller data can leak over the API and increases blast radius if a client can call /api/sales directly.
findings.recommendedSolution: Move seller filtering into authenticated server/API query: ADMIN gets all, SELLER gets where vendorId=session.user.id.
findings.verificationSteps: SELLER GET /api/sales should return only own sales; direct API response must not contain other sellers.
findings.reproducibility: Previously reproducible from missing route/session checks. Guard and test coverage now prevent the audited path.

findings.evidence: Fixed in app/api/orders/route.tsx by replacing read/check/update stock deductions with conditional updateMany calls: ProductVariant stock uses stock >= quantity at lines 168-173 and simple Product stock uses productStock >= quantity at lines 238-243. Both paths throw out-of-stock when update count is not 1. Verification passed: Prisma validate, lint, typecheck, tests and production build.
findings.description: Stock decrement is now atomic for product and variant stock in checkout.
findings.businessImpact: Concurrent purchases can oversell the last unit.
findings.recommendedSolution: Keep checkout stock deduction inside the transaction and add a live concurrent checkout integration test against PostgreSQL.
findings.verificationSteps: Run two concurrent checkout requests for the final unit; exactly one should commit. Static verification: app/api/orders/route.tsx contains conditional updateMany stock >= quantity guards.
findings.reproducibility: The non-atomic read/check/update pattern is present in code; a concurrent checkout test is still required to observe oversell in a live DB.

findings.evidence: Partially fixed in app/api/orders/route.tsx. Checkout now reads/creates seller Inventory rows and decrements existing Inventory.quantity atomically with quantity >= requested quantity at lines 83-113, in the same transaction as Product/ProductVariant stock deduction. Remaining schema risk: Prisma @@unique([productId, productVariantId, sellerId]) does not prevent duplicate simple-product rows in PostgreSQL when productVariantId is NULL; no migration was created in this pass.
findings.description: Checkout no longer fully bypasses the seller-wise Inventory table, but the database still needs a partial unique index for simple-product inventory rows and a backfill/preflight before Inventory can be the sole source of truth.
findings.businessImpact: Marketplace stock, seller dashboards, and fulfillment can diverge from actual sellable inventory.
findings.recommendedSolution: Add a PostgreSQL preflight for duplicate simple Inventory rows, then create a partial unique index on Inventory(productId, sellerId) WHERE productVariantId IS NULL; after backfill, make checkout rely on Inventory as the primary stock source.
findings.verificationSteps: Checkout should update Inventory.quantity for the correct seller/product/variant. Migration preflight should verify no duplicate simple-product Inventory rows before creating the partial unique index.
findings.reproducibility: Checkout code path bypasses the seller-wise Inventory model entirely.

findings.evidence: Fixed in app/api/orders/route.tsx and lib/orders/checkout-calculations.ts. Checkout now aggregates immutable item snapshots with calculateOrderTotals at line 306, persists Order subtotal/tax/grandTotal fields at lines 307-319, creates SellerOrder totals at lines 322-342, and links OrderItem rows to sellerOrderId at line 346. tests/ecommerce.test.ts verifies GST split and order/seller total snapshots.
findings.description: Order-level GST and grand totals are persisted from item tax snapshots during checkout.
findings.businessImpact: Invoices, admin reporting, payment reconciliation and GST returns can be wrong.
findings.recommendedSolution: Add a database-backed checkout integration test that creates taxable items and verifies Order, SellerOrder, OrderItem and Sale rows after commit.
findings.verificationSteps: npm test -- --test-reporter=spec; create a taxable order and verify Order.subtotal, taxTotal, grandTotal and SellerOrder totals equal item sums.
findings.reproducibility: Order aggregate tax/total fields remain their schema defaults during the observed create-order path.

findings.evidence: Fixed on 2026-07-25: app/layout.tsx no longer imports Inter from next/font/google and <body> no longer depends on inter.className. Verification: node_modules\.bin\next.cmd build exited 0 and completed production build successfully.
findings.description: Production build depends on network access to Google Fonts.
findings.businessImpact: CI or deployment with restricted egress cannot produce a build artifact.
findings.recommendedSolution: Self-host the font with next/font/local or remove external font dependency.
findings.verificationSteps: Run node_modules\.bin\next.cmd build; expected exit code 0 with no Google Fonts fetch failure.
findings.reproducibility: Previously reproducible via build failure. No longer reproducible after removing next/font/google dependency; production build now passes.

findings.evidence: Fixed on 2026-07-25: next.config.ts no longer contains typescript.ignoreBuildErrors. Verification: node_modules\.bin\tsc.cmd --noEmit exited 0 and node_modules\.bin\next.cmd build exited 0 while running TypeScript during build.
findings.description: Production builds are configured to ignore TypeScript errors.
findings.businessImpact: Broken typed contracts can ship to production even when typecheck fails.
findings.recommendedSolution: Remove ignoreBuildErrors and enforce typecheck before build in CI.
findings.verificationSteps: Run node_modules\.bin\tsc.cmd --noEmit and node_modules\.bin\next.cmd build; both should exit 0, and future TypeScript build errors should fail the build.
findings.reproducibility: Previously confirmed by next.config.ts lines 16-18. No longer present in current next.config.ts.

findings.businessImpact: Unauthenticated or wrong-role users may upload images into application storage and associate misleading ownership metadata.
findings.recommendedSolution: Add Uploadthing middleware that requires session and route-specific roles; return real user id metadata.
findings.verificationSteps: Unauthenticated upload attempts fail; successful uploads contain session user id.

findings.verificationSteps: eslint fails on intentional hook rule violations and passes after fixes.

findings.evidence: Lines 3-8 validate only categoryId, subCategoryId, hsnCodeId and hsnOverrideEnabled; NewProductForm useForm at lines 234-245 has no Zod resolver.
findings.description: Product form/API validation is incomplete for prices, stock, SKU, barcode, variants and SEO fields.
findings.businessImpact: Invalid catalog data can reach APIs and fail late or persist inconsistently.
findings.recommendedSolution: Create a full shared Zod product schema and use it in React Hook Form and API handlers.
findings.verificationSteps: Negative price, missing SKU, duplicate barcode and invalid variants should produce field/API errors.

findings.evidence: Lines 54-56 and 78-82 increment quantity without stock limits; AddToCartButton lines 11-18 dispatches simple products without stock checks.
findings.description: Cart can exceed available stock before checkout.
findings.businessImpact: Customers experience late checkout failures and unreliable availability.
findings.recommendedSolution: Carry stock and variant availability into cart items, cap quantity, and revalidate server-side before order placement.
findings.verificationSteps: Product with stock 1 cannot be increased to quantity 2 in cart.

findings.evidence: Lines 41-45 compute subtotal from cart salePrice; lines 136-143 compute total as shipping plus subtotal only. No GST/discount/seller split is shown.
findings.description: Checkout UI totals do not include GST tax lines.
findings.businessImpact: Customer-facing total may differ from statutory invoice/payment totals.
findings.recommendedSolution: Fetch server-priced checkout quote including GST, shipping, discounts and grand total; render CGST/SGST/IGST breakdown.
findings.verificationSteps: Checkout for taxable item displays matching tax and grand total returned by server quote API.

findings.evidence: Invoice component renders an order but order creation does not persist order aggregate GST totals, and invoice page app/(back-office)/dashboard/orders/[id]/invoice/page.tsx lines 5-7 fetches any order id without local auth check.
findings.description: Invoice rendering depends on incomplete and weakly protected order data.
findings.businessImpact: GST invoices can be inaccurate or exposed by URL.
findings.recommendedSolution: Persist immutable invoice snapshots at order/payment time and protect invoice route by owner/admin/seller scope.
findings.verificationSteps: Invoice totals match OrderItem tax snapshots and unauthorized users cannot load other invoices.

findings.evidence: Only app/loading.tsx exists; repository inventory found no error.tsx or not-found.tsx files. Localized pages use notFound(), but no custom not-found boundary exists.
findings.description: Error and not-found handling is incomplete across route groups.
findings.businessImpact: Users see generic failures and recovery paths during broken fetches or missing products/categories.
findings.recommendedSolution: Add route-group error.tsx, not-found.tsx, and empty states for storefront and dashboard tables.
findings.verificationSteps: Force product/category/order not found and API failure; UI shows branded actionable states.

findings.evidence: Static scan found React Redux hooks in components/Checkout/NavButtons.tsx and components/Onboarding/NavButtons.tsx without a top-level "use client" directive.
findings.description: Some hook-using components rely on being imported only from client parents instead of declaring their own client boundary.
findings.businessImpact: Future server imports can cause App Router build/runtime errors.
findings.recommendedSolution: Add explicit "use client" to hook-using components or split server/client components clearly.
findings.verificationSteps: Import components from server page in a test branch; build should not fail due missing client directive.

findings.evidence: Lines 7-10 set title "Limi Ecommerce" and description "Generated by create next app"; line 14 hardcodes html lang="en" while app/[lang] routes exist.
findings.description: Global metadata and language do not match Nxbazaar.in or localized pages.
findings.businessImpact: Poor search snippets, brand inconsistency and incorrect language semantics for Hindi/Marathi.
findings.recommendedSolution: Set Nxbazaar.in metadata, add generateMetadata for product/category pages and localized html lang/alternate links.
findings.verificationSteps: Rendered /, /hi and /mr HTML has correct title, description, lang and alternates.

findings.evidence: Lines 52 and 69 use raw img tags with empty alt text; other raw img usage appears in BlogCard, blogs detail, Footer, RecentTrainings and OrderCard.
findings.description: Key product/content images bypass next/image optimization and have weak alt text.
findings.businessImpact: Slower LCP, poorer accessibility and less predictable image sizing.
findings.recommendedSolution: Use next/image with stable dimensions/sizes and meaningful alt text for product/content images.
findings.verificationSteps: Lighthouse image audits pass and product carousel images expose meaningful accessible names.

findings.evidence: Lines 207-212 return JSON containing raw error; similar error, fields appear across many API routes.
findings.description: API routes return raw error objects to clients.
findings.businessImpact: Implementation details or sensitive database errors can leak to users/attackers.
findings.recommendedSolution: Log server-side, return safe error codes/messages, and map expected validation errors explicitly.
findings.verificationSteps: Force Prisma error and response contains only safe code/message, not stack/database object.

findings.evidence: Lines 46-54 return user with status and emailVerified, but authorize does not reject status=false or unverified users.
findings.description: Inactive or unverified accounts can authenticate.
findings.businessImpact: Suspended sellers/users or unverified accounts may access protected areas.
findings.recommendedSolution: Enforce status/emailVerified policy during authorize or in route guards according to role requirements.
findings.verificationSteps: Inactive account login fails or receives restricted session with no dashboard/API access.

findings.evidence: AuditLog model exists at lines 1268-1276, and ProductHistory exists in schema, but feature inventory found no audit/history routes or dashboard pages outside schema/product history writes.
findings.description: Audit trail is modeled but not exposed as a reviewable admin/seller feature.
findings.businessImpact: Operational teams cannot trace changes, investigate disputes or satisfy audit requirements efficiently.
findings.recommendedSolution: Create audit log service and dashboards for product, order, inventory, HSN and user role changes.
findings.verificationSteps: Changing product/HSN/order status creates visible immutable audit entries with actor and before/after values.

findings.evidence: Language files exist and app/[lang] routes exist, but root layout hardcodes lang="en" and scan found metadata only in app/layout.tsx; not all front-end routes have [lang] equivalents.
findings.description: English/Hindi/Marathi implementation is partial.
findings.businessImpact: Localized users may hit English-only pages, incorrect metadata and inconsistent URL coverage.
findings.recommendedSolution: Define locale middleware/routing, localized layouts, metadata, and complete translation coverage for storefront flows.
findings.verificationSteps: For en/hi/mr, product/category/cart/checkout/support pages render translated UI and correct lang metadata.

findings.evidence: Payment and seller wallet models exist, but feature inventory found no refund files, no wishlist/review/returns implementation files, and no payment provider API/webhook routes.
findings.description: Important marketplace workflows are missing or only represented in schema.
findings.businessImpact: Customer trust, seller operations and support workflows are incomplete for production marketplace use.
findings.recommendedSolution: Prioritize refunds/returns, reviews, wishlist, payment webhooks, seller settlements and support dispute workflows.
findings.verificationSteps: End-to-end tests cover payment, refund, return, review and seller payout lifecycle.

findings.evidence: getAppEnv validates env with Zod at lines 39-47, but db.ts reads process.env.DATABASE_URL directly at lines 8-10 and several routes/components read process.env directly.
findings.description: Central environment validation exists but is not consistently used.
findings.businessImpact: Missing config fails late at runtime, as seen in Redis check failure.
findings.recommendedSolution: Import getAppEnv in server modules and expose a typed public env helper for NEXT_PUBLIC values.
findings.verificationSteps: Missing required env fails at startup with one clear message before serving requests.

findings.evidence: Scripts include dev/build/start/lint/typecheck and translation/redis helpers, but no general "test" script.
findings.description: There is no standard test command.
findings.businessImpact: CI cannot run a unified regression suite for checkout, auth, inventory and tax logic.
findings.recommendedSolution: Add a test runner and define pnpm test; keep test:translations as a targeted script.
findings.verificationSteps: pnpm test runs unit/integration tests and exits nonzero on failures.

findings.evidence: Dependencies include both flowbite/flowbite-react and shadcn/Radix-style components; carousel libraries include nuka-carousel, react-multi-carousel and swiper.
findings.description: UI/dependency stack has overlapping packages.
findings.businessImpact: Bundle size, design consistency and maintenance burden increase.
findings.recommendedSolution: Choose primary UI and carousel stacks; remove unused packages after usage audit.
findings.verificationSteps: Bundle analyzer confirms removed unused dependencies and no import regressions.

findings.evidence: Lines 37-49 render input and error text, but do not set aria-invalid or aria-describedby linking the error.
findings.description: Form error accessibility can be improved.
findings.businessImpact: Screen-reader users may not receive clear field error context.
findings.recommendedSolution: Add stable error ids, aria-invalid and aria-describedby across form inputs.
findings.verificationSteps: Accessibility test verifies errored fields announce labels and errors.

findings.evidence: Repository has route groups for app/(front-end), app/(back-office), app/[lang], API routes, lib, actions, redux, workers and Prisma migrations.
findings.description: The high-level structure matches a Next.js App Router marketplace, but domain boundaries are split across routes, actions and components.
findings.businessImpact: Feature work can become inconsistent unless domain services and auth policies are centralized.
findings.recommendedSolution: Document module boundaries and centralize domain services for checkout, catalog, tax, inventory and auth.
findings.verificationSteps: New features can be implemented through documented service APIs with tests.

findings.description: No repository-local agent instructions were available to read.
findings.businessImpact: Future automated work lacks project-specific local guidance beyond prompt instructions.
